test_drop_columns: test the drop() method on a polars DataFrame and LazyFrame to remove specified columns
test_drop_in_place: test the drop_in_place() method on a polars DataFrame to remove and return a column as a Series
test_drop_nulls: test the drop_nulls() method on a polars DataFrame to remove rows containing null values
test_drop_nulls_lazy: test the drop_nulls() method on a polars LazyFrame with selector-based subset filtering
test_drop_nans: test the drop_nans() method on a polars DataFrame and LazyFrame to remove rows with NaN values
test_drop_strict: test the drop() method with strict=True and strict=False for handling non-existent columns
test_drop_regex: test the drop() method with a regex-based selector to match column names
test_drop_invalid_selector: test that drop() raises InvalidOperationError for invalid selector operands
